description: This file defines the interface and constants for Bluetooth L2CAP handling in Zephyr OS, including buffer size calculations, channel states, callback structures, server registration, and connection management.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_server_register
methods.description: Registers an L2CAP server for a specific PSM, enabling incoming connection handling.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_br_server_register
methods.description: Registers an L2CAP server for BR/EDR connections.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_connect
methods.description: Establishes an L2CAP channel connection by PSM.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_send
methods.description: Sends data over an L2CAP channel.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_give_credits
methods.description: Provides credits to the remote for segmented SDU reception.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_recv_complete
methods.description: Completes the reception of segmented data on an L2CAP channel.
